understood_as: Replace the deferred 40-job time-ablation study with an actor architecture comparison. Implement, unit-test, GPU-smoke and verify exact restoration now; do not launch the main 60 jobs before validation review.
question: Does bounded action-observation history improve joint exploitation and recovery, and do GRU or causal attention improve on a history MLP given the same information?
history: Eight observation tokens: seven completed (pre-action observation, selected action) pairs, then current observation with a zero-coded unknown action. Left-pad missing pairs with zeros and valid=false; current token is valid. Append only actual valid controlled transitions. Clear on world reset and initial adaptation attachment; waits occur only at those boundaries and do not populate history. Goal switches neither reset history nor insert waits. No variant, collision flag, future action or earlier hidden state. All three history actors use exactly this window and the current commanded goal. Current MLP sees only the current observation and commanded goal.
architecture: All clocks retained. Per-token actor CNN32 and Dense128 ReLU; current MLP two1024 layers, history MLP flattened eight tokens and two704 layers, GRU576 with zero initial hidden at each window, Transformer six pre-LN blocks, width128/four heads/FF512, learned eight positions, causal valid-token attention, dropout0. Actor specs are defined in src/hackrl/spatial_architecture.py; widths chosen by parameter counts only. Actual initialized actor counts and throughput must be reported; not a matched-compute comparison.
auxiliaries: Identical separate current-observation critic in all conditions: CNN32/Dense512/four512/value. Identical current-observation DualLeoQ teacher: CNN16/four512/BatchRenorm. Neither receives history. Critic parameters are not shared with actor. Teacher size and learning rule are fixed, not its learned weights or visited data. Different actor paths can change downstream data and teacher learning.

parameter_matching.contract: Actor CNN/token encoder weights are shared across positions within each model, never across actor and critic. Validate these counts on actual initialized GPU models, including convolution, embeddings and output heads. Auxiliary initial parameter and normalization-state hashes must match across architectures.

source_contracts.evaluation: src/hackrl/spatial_time_history_eval.py with spatial_architecture history_api; src/hackrl/spatial_recovery_probe.py intervention_step and records_from_trace
source_contracts.provenance: GPU validator requires a clean committed tree and records execution SHA plus SHA256 for all source and script files in its RAID manifest.

learning: Fixed normal12 pretraining512; full-state fork to delivery adaptation q=0 and q=.1 with uniform0..8 forced waits,4096 updates. Original PPO and teacher optimization, observations/rewards/action mapping and64 physical tick horizon. Original linear BC schedule global0..4608 without restart. Forced waits are outside both learner buffers and normalization updates. Same update and collector-slot budget, not a guarantee of identical valid sample counts.
failures: Retain every seed; at final pretraining, natural fixed delay0 mode and sample must each be>=90% for the descriptive normal-capability flag. This is not a seed filter or replacement rule. Numerically executable branches remain in the planned matrix. Numerical, integrity or storage failure pauses with evidence and no automatic budget extension.
evaluation: Same starts and RNGs as spatial_random_delay_v1:16 fixture transformations, mode primary and sample8 secondary; delays0 /1..8 /10,12; pure fixed, pure mutant and one-shot wall block. Report per-seed/per-delay mutant success, wall crossing, control length and paired kernel return together with fixed success. Failure lengths cannot be called successful path lengths. Known10/12 evaluation points are follow-up tests, not untouched holdouts or new-map generalization. Independent learning seeds, not episodes, are replication units.
restore_contract: All policy/critic/teacher parameters, optimizer states, BatchRenorm, RNGs, environment/goal state, seven-pair history, delay/kernel state, exposure and update counters. Disk restore and subsequent full update must match uninterrupted full state and metrics exactly (maximum absolute difference0); hash mismatch or nonzero difference fails validation. Both branches use the identical normal checkpoint hash. Frozen evaluation must leave full learner serialization unchanged.
fork_transition: At the normal world-reset boundary (all tick0), retain policy/critic/teacher/Adam/BatchRenorm, global update and learner/world RNGs. command_delivery resets command counters and activates the delivery goal. attach_delay initializes separate seed-derived kernel/delay streams and exposure counters, chooses each world's hidden kernel and performs its initial wait; history is empty after this. q0/q.1 differ only in the fixed-probability argument. Save both full resulting branch states before updating; original normal full state remains immutable.
baseline: All four architectures retrain. The previous current MLP shares an actor-critic encoder and is historical reference only, not a reusable control for this new separate-critic family. This is a parameter-matched actor-family comparison, not a claim that architecture is the only numerical implementation difference.

validation.contract: Each actor: one normal update; normal continuation and disk-restored repeat; q0 and q.1 each one update and disk-restored repeat; full frozen evaluation for both. Full512x64 shapes. Disposable two-update normal state marked global512 only to test adaptation schedule plumbing, never a learned science checkpoint. No reward-based selection. Any retry is counted separately; a failed receipt stops automatic retries.

storage.gate: Before first checkpoint and every save, record free bytes on home and RAID and measure existing validation/scale runs. Require RAID free bytes >= projected remaining retained/overlap/artifact writes + max8GiB or20% reserve; assert every checkpoint is below its256MiB bound. No migration or deletion of existing runs.

supersedes_for_priority_only: spatial_time_history_v1: preserved A/B GPU diagnostics and CPU validation, no main training; C/D full GPU validation incomplete. No claim that the 40-job study ran.
